name: Dating is Hell
source:
A cute game about how a magical girl gets kidnapped by her demonic nonbinary nemesis, for what you might ask???

To go on a cute date

This won't end badly
At all~!

[From [url=https://desichan.itch.io/dating-is-hell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于魔法女孩如何被她的恶魔般的非二元宿敌绑架的可爱游戏，你可能会问什么？？？

去一次可爱的约会

这不会有糟糕的结局
根本就~！

[来自[url=https://desichan.itch.io/dating-is-hell]Itch.io[/url]]
